name: Model Theft
blurb: Weight exfiltration and model extraction through APIs, and what providers disclose about protecting them.

items.name: Protecting the model itself
items.note: The joint secure-development guidelines cover weight protection, API extraction hardening, and release trade-offs.

items.name: Model extraction, formally
items.note: NIST AI 100-2 defines model stealing and extraction through query access, with known limits of current defenses.

items.name: Exfiltration techniques
items.note: MITRE ATLAS catalogues ML artifact collection and exfiltration as observed adversary technique classes.
